// the reference resource: every kind of configuration text
# a hash comment
/* a block
   comment */
resource "container" "web" {
  image    = "nginx:1.27"
  replicas = 3
  enabled  = true
  owner    = null
  message  = "line one\nport < 1024 & \"quoted\""
  network  = resource.network.main.meta.name
  port     = max(8080, 8443)
  greeting = "hello ${variable.name}!"

  script = <<-EOF
    echo "#{{ .Vars.greeting }}"
  EOF

  volume {
    source = "/data"
  }
}
